caption:
3 things I fix in every split squat 👇

1️⃣ Give yourself enough space — front foot far enough forward
2️⃣ Drop straight down, not forward — back knee towards the floor
3️⃣ Small lean forward = more glutes. Stay tall = more quads

Go slow on the way down. Strong legs today, independent at 70.

Glutes or quads — where do you feel it?
Comment "START" and I'll help you start.
